outcome: Maternal complications (postpartum hemorrhage, risk of hysterectomy, infection, deep venous thrombosis, longer hospital stay)
cohort: All patients who underwent caesarean section at Pt. JNM Medical College associated with Dr. BRAM Hospital, Raipur, between May 2018 and April 2019.
finding: The most common indication for caesarean section was Robson's Group 1 (32.67%), followed by Robson's Group 5 (27.47%).
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery significantly impacts maternal and fetal outcomes, increasing the risk of postpartum hemorrhage, hysterectomy, infection, deep venous thrombosis, and longer hospital stays.
